title: DomainEntry — shared definition for the did-management/domain/* spec family
description: Canonical DomainEntry $def referenced by every did-management/domain/* specification. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

name.description: Hosting domain name (e.g. `did.example.com`). Compared case-insensitively; producers SHOULD emit lowercase canonical form.

status.description: Domain lifecycle state. A `disabled` domain still serves existing DIDs in read-only mode for the host's configured grace period before purge becomes eligible.

defaultDomain.description: When `true`, this domain is the host's default — new DIDs created without an explicit domain are hosted here. Exactly one entry SHOULD carry `defaultDomain: true`.

purgeAt.description: Earliest RFC3339 timestamp at which the host's background sweep is allowed to purge content for a disabled domain. Operators with administrative authority MAY override the wait via `domain/purge`.
